title: La Meridiana de noche: los alumnos del castillo
description: docs/chapter-2.md § Night and the way home. At night the pupils of the castle floor the party is on (the first) climb out of the grates, a room's group each, with their own figures and gaits; the group that catches the party is the fight. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: { const g = window.gerard.game, at = g.world(g.position.x - 16, g.position.z - 10); g.frame({ x: at.x, y: 1, z: at.z }, 18); }

steps.caption: Night on the Meridiana: the first floor's pupils out of the grates, a room's group each, walking their rounds

steps.eval: { const g = window.gerard.game, h = g.nightHunters.find(h => h.id === 'night-1'), at = g.world(h.x, h.z); g.frame({ x: at.x, y: 1, z: at.z }, 3.6); }

steps.caption: Up close in the dark, the first group (La Chivata and El Repetidor) walking its round, each in its own gait, its gum glowing a little

steps.eval: { const g = window.gerard.game, h = g.nightHunters.find(h => h.id === 'night-1'), at = g.world(h.x, h.z); g.frame({ x: at.x, y: 1, z: at.z }, 2.4); }
